Approved evidence

TrustScale / e2f

org.e2f

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. Humanus explicitly offers ranked/rated responses, expert-written supervised examples, annotation, benchmarks/red teaming and multilingual services. Qualification is managed human training/evaluation data, distinct from automated Argus claims checking. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
